name: Faustino Gran (Relais & Châteaux)
description: Historic palaces in Ciutadella's old town turned into a boutique hotel of the Relais & Châteaux collection. Rooms on Carrer de Sant Sebastià and Sa Muradeta, a restaurant working with local seasonal produce, a spa with a pool (Casa de Pau) and private boats for the coves. The island's urban luxury: old stone, quiet lanes and the harbour two steps away.

practicalInfo.acceso: Carrer de Sant Sebastià 9-11, Ciutadella old town.
practicalInfo.horario: Seasonal opening: check 2026 dates on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: Faustino restaurant, spa with pool (Casa de Pau), private boats for excursions, several palaces in the historic centre.
